question: If an angle of a right-angled triangle is 35°, then find the other angles.
solution:
Given:

An angle of a right-angled triangle is 35°.

Concept used:

All internet angle of a triangle sum up to 180°.

Calculation:

Hence, the measure of the third angle

⇒ 180° - 90° - 35°

⇒ 55°

**∴ The other angles are 90° and 55°.**
